sentences.en: I showed you guys what I had bought so far, but now I've bought even more. So, let's learn some house essentials in English.
sentences.tc: 我向你們展示了到目前為止我買的東西，但現在我買了更多。那麼，讓我們用英語學習一些家居必需品。

sentences.en: I bought a couch.
sentences.tc: 我買了一張沙發。

sentences.en: I love this couch. It's so comfy. A comfy couch is very important for a home.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡這個沙發。真是太舒服了。一張舒適的沙發對一個家來說非常重要。

sentences.en: I love the color and I think it really "ties the room together".
sentences.tc: 我喜歡這種顏色，我認為它確實「將房間連接在一起」。

sentences.en: When something ties the room together, it means it really synchronizes with everything in the room and makes it special?
sentences.tc: 當某些東西將房間聯繫在一起時，是否意味著它確實與房間中的所有東西同步並使其變得特別？

sentences.en: What do you think of my new couch? Is it your style... or maybe not so much?
sentences.tc: 你覺得我的新沙發怎麼樣？這是你的風格嗎……或者也許不是那麼多？

sentences.en: I got a plant. Of course, plants are the most important part of a home.
sentences.tc: 我有一株植物。當然，植物是家庭中最重要的部分。

sentences.en: I want to fill this place up with plants completely. Plants bring: abundance, prosperity, and money. It's a good idea to have plants in your home.
sentences.tc: 我想讓這個地方完全被植物填滿。植物帶來：豐富、繁榮和金錢。在家裡養一些植物是個好主意。

sentences.en: They're so pretty. The air feels so much cleaner,.
